name: PlayStation 2 — no shippable core
license: NONE — no viable open libretro core exists
blocked_reason: Engineering + licensing: AetherSX2 is proprietary (cannot ship or fork); Play! has no stable libretro port and poor compat; PCSX2 has no maintained libretro core. PS2 also mandates a BIOS dump and high JIT perf (no iOS path). Revisit if Play! matures or PCSX2-libretro revives. Slot reserved.
